text:
Owen Brooks: Hey team — excited to join! Quick first-day checklist: I accepted the org invite but Product Kit in Figma still shows "Request access". Also where do folks keep the canonical PRD template, the research consent & payment process, and how do I request write access to design tokens? Thanks!

Priya Shah: welcome Owen :tada: I just resent the invite and added you to Designers. If you see "Request access" it's usually account conflict with personal Google. Try SSO or incognito. If that fails paste a screenshot and I will force-add you.

Owen Brooks: Still blocked after SSO. Screenshot attached.

OnboardBot: Owen Brooks provisioned to groups: Designers, Prototypes, Design-System-Readers.

Carla Mendes: Hey Owen  I'm your PM. PRDs and roadmap live in Notion > Product > PRDs (link shared in onboarding). I can add you to the roadmap space nowor a quick read.

Priya Shah: Quick fix steps that help 90% of the time:
```
1) Sign out of Figma
2) Sign in via company SSO (Okta)
3) Open invite link in private/incognito window
4) If still blocked, paste screenshot here
```

Priya Shah: Ok force-added you to the Product Kit file and to the Design System library. Can you confirm?

Owen Brooks: Can open it now 44d Thanks! Next  how do I request write access to design tokens/repos? I want to propose a token for spacing utilities.

Zoe Li: Research ops here. Consent templates + payment flow are in Notion > Research > Ops. Payments go through Stripe Connect; we use prepaid cards for ad-hoc testers. Submit a Payment Request on the Research Ops page before scheduling.

Priya Shah: For token write access open a PR in the design-tokens repo and tag @design-system-review. Small changes go through a two-reviewer flow. I can add you to the editors group after your first PR.Let me know the repo handle you want.

Carla Mendes: Also FYI: handoff flow: link PRD in Notion under Design Assets, add eng assignee, attach Figma prototype and include the Handoff Checklist frame. We usually put export naming examples in the PR description.

Owen Brooks: Where's the Handoff Checklist? I missed that in the Product Kit.

Priya Shah: It's a Figma page called "Handoff Checklist" in Product Kit and a Notion checklist template under Design > Handoff. I just shared both links in DM.

Zoe Li: If you want to shadow research, we have new-hire slots Tue 3pm and Fri 10am. I can add you to Lookback and the research calendar. Also tag uploads with study id (study-YYYYMMDD) and add tag "research-eval" so metrics pick it up.

Owen Brooks: Tue 3pm works. One last thing 914 4bb f4e6 f44d 389 — who do I ping for a loaner Mac and for access to the design tokens repo?

Priya Shah: Ping #people-ops for hardware checkout (or use Hardware form in Notion). I will add you to the design-tokens repo today. Welcome aboard and excited to have you on the product design squad!
